issues.desc: background.md uses the term "wrapper-root" from the first sentence (line 1) without any inline definition. The clarifying phrase "(metadataRoot != gitRoot)" appears only in index.json description, not in background.md itself. A new reader of background.md alone cannot determine what wrapper-root means without access to index.json.

CHK-004 context says "the CHK-003 pattern" to describe the projectRoot->gitCwd rename, but CHK-003 in this story is about project-level scans (resolveProjectGitRoot), not parameter renames. The intended reference is apparently to B-6666 CHK-003 (validate-channel/concept rename), making this a cross-story reference that is not labeled as such. An implementer may be confused about which pattern is meant.

CHK-003 context states the project-level scans should use "the resolver module already exposes resolveProjectGitRoot internally" but resolveProjectGitRoot is a non-exported internal function in story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts (no export keyword). The context does not flag that the implementer must first export this function before CHK-003 callers can import it, which is a required pre-step not made explicit.
